title: Cartwise+ Membership Priority Delivery Upgrade Allotments
content:
Priority Delivery upgrades are allotted by Cartwise+ Membership plan at the start of each paid period.

| Plan | Priority Delivery upgrades allotted per paid period | Unused upgrades carry into the next period |
|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | 0 | no |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 0 | no |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | 0 | no |
| Cartwise+ Annual | 0 | no |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | 4 | no |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | 12 | no |

## Reading the table

- Only Cartwise+ Family Annual (4 per period) and Cartwise+ Premier Annual (12 per period) receive upgrades; the other four plans receive none.
- No plan carries unused upgrades into the next period.
